title: DocumentRecord
description: Metadata inside Workspace.documents. Binary content is fetched separately; no local/server path or binary payload is exposed.

id.description: Opaque server-generated lowercase UUID. Clients must not derive a path from it or from name.

mediaType.description: Validated content type; immutable after upload.

sizeBytes.description: Exact immutable byte length, 1 through 20 MiB inclusive. Kotlin consumers use Long.

sha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 of the exact immutable uploaded bytes. App verifies downloaded/cache bytes before opening.

createdAt.description: Immutable server creation instant in UTC ISO-8601 form with Z, optional fractional seconds (up to nanoseconds).
